lock.reason: Build 141 was uploaded to App Store Connect with elevatr.llc.quackdoku on 2026-10-13. Apple ties the app record, its TestFlight builds, and every future update to this ID, and it can never be changed or reused. Players never see it; they see the App Store name and the home-screen name, which you can still change.
